thread:
lucas: Hi - brand new here, second day. Quick q: where do we store canonical docs and templates? I want to copy the runbook and a 1:1 template but Duplicate is greyed out.
devex-bot: Quick checklist: 1) Confirm you're in the Redwood workspace 2) Is the page a DB template or locked? 3) If "Can view" only, request edit via the three-dot menu.
lucas: I'm in the Redwood workspace. On desktop the page loads but Duplicate is disabled; I don't see an owner.
miri: Hey Lucas 44b - welcome! If it's a database template you won't be able to duplicate the master page; instead go to the target DB -> New -> choose the template. If it's a locked master page, owners sometimes lock it to prevent edits.
dena: Tagging @people-ops. We keep some starter templates view-only to avoid accidental changes. Which templates do you need?
lucas: Incident runbook and the "1:1 + goals" starter.
people-ops: Hi Lucas - thanks. Incident runbooks live in Company Home > Eng > Runbooks (DB). Use the DB's New -> Incident runbook template. The 1:1 starter sits under People Ops > Templates as a standalone page; I just flipped your perms to "Can edit".
lucas: Yay duplicate appeared after refresh, thank you. Where should I move the copied runbook so the oncall team can see it?
miri: Best practice: operational runbooks go under eng-runbooks (Company Home > Eng > eng-runbooks) and are shared with eng-oncall. Personal 1:1 notes should remain in My Workspace or People Ops > Personal 1:1s.
ops-bot: Reminder: add an "Owner" front-matter line at the top of team docs and set the Owner property if the page is DB-managed. This helps oncall lookups.
lucas: Good call. How do I find the owner quickly next time?
people-ops: Hover near the title for the Owner property, or check the top doc-meta block. If it's empty, add a small block: Owner, Last updated, Contact. Ping #devex with the page link if owner is unclear.
lucas: Will do. One more tiny thing: mobile hides some controls; heads up for other new hires.
miri: Yep mobile sometimes hides the three-dot menu and template dropdown. Use desktop if you need Duplicate or Page history.
lucas: Thanks all! I'll move my copies to eng-runbooks + My Workspace and add doc-meta. Appreciate the help :tada:
people-ops: Welcome again Lucas! Drop the links if you want us to confirm permissions/owner."
